description: Analyst price-target consensus for one US stock: mean, high and low target, the buy/hold/sell analyst counts, and about 13 months of month-by-month consensus history (mean target, rating split, and the high/avg/low band for the latest month). Use for "what is the Street price target on AAPL", "how has the AAPL target moved this year". Sourced live from Nasdaq's public analyst data.
name: analyst_price_targets
title: Analyst Price Targets
